interpretation: All nine legacy direction/depth cases pass their recorded semantic checks on JDTLS with corrected command arguments. Modern subtype also passes.
Modern supertype and three legacy parent-change cases retain stale early acquisition/expansion results before correct settled replies. Legacy edited fixtures compile independently.
Modern supertype additionally exits nonzero during shutdown, without a harness kill.
The reducer reports three missing immediate expansions where preceding fresh acquisition failed; raw failed acquisitions are retained.

Archive validation discovered two extra zero-byte runtime files outside the original inventory. Every originally sealed file still matches its hash. Extras are archived explicitly; the original inventory is unchanged. The cause is unproven.
JVMD declares all fourteen cases unsupported. This pilot is not fully sealed or eligible for comparative performance claims.
